title: The Flaw in Private Equity's Value Creation Plan #shorts
description:
The real issue isn't execution, it's design. PE value creation plans are built to close deals, not run companies. Shared ownership becomes no ownership, a structural failure where every party assumes someone else is in charge.
#PrivateEquity #VentureCapital #BusinessStrategy #Investment #Leadership
